name: Tails of Iron II: Blood and Brine
storyline:
Arlo has survived everything the frozen North could throw at him, but his next adventure begins with something a little different.

Two shipwrecked sailors, Jaimie and Sam, have washed ashore with an unusual plan: build an aquarium filled with rare sea life, attract visitors to Hardshell Brook and earn enough coin to repair their vessel.

There’s just one problem.

Someone needs to do the fishing.

Armed with a fishing rod, Arlo can explore fishing spots around Hardshell Brook and hunt down 32 different aquatic creatures, gradually filling the aquarium one catch at a time.

Fishing brings a different pace to life in the Ratdom, but don't expect every trip to the water to be peaceful. Some of the creatures beneath the surface would much rather make a meal of Arlo than end up behind aquarium glass.

And the longer Arlo spends helping Jaimie and Sam, the clearer it becomes that there may be more to their story than they first revealed.
summary: Blood and Brine, the free expansion for Tails of Iron 2: Whiskers of Winter. Leave the frozen wastes of the North behind and travel to Hardshell Brook, a coastal settlement where new characters, dangerous creatures and something altogether more sinister are waiting beneath the waves.
